texts.orig: quadric. In Section 2, the definition of the cutcurve with its characterization is introduced. In Section 2.1, we study the relationship between the resultant, the first subresultant and the cutcurve. In Section 3, we explore the relationship between the singularities of the cutcurve and those of the intersection curve. In Section 4 we present the expression of the cutcurve in terms of the coefficients of the implicit equation of the quadric, its relation with the silhouette curves of the torus and the quadric, and a characterization of the cutcurve singularities. Section 5 is dedicated to presenting examples which illustrate the results presented in the paper.
